duas.title: Ramadan Moon Sighting
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ahillahu 'alayna bil-amni wal-eemani was-salamati wal-Islam, Rabbi wa Rabbukallah
duas.translation: O Allah, let this moon come upon us with security, faith, safety, and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.

duas.title: Sehri Dua (Opening Fast)
duas.arabic: وَبِصَوْمِ غَدٍ نَّوَيْتُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
duas.transliteration: Wa bisawmi ghadin nawaytu min shahri Ramadan
duas.translation: I intend to keep the fast for tomorrow in the month of Ramadan.

duas.title: Iftar Dua (Breaking Fast)
duas.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Dhahabaz-zama'u wabtallatil-'urooqu wa thabatal-ajru in sha' Allah
duas.translation: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

duas.title: Laylatul Qadr (Night of Decree)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.translation: O Allah, You are the One who pardons greatly, and You love to pardon, so pardon me.

duas.title: First Ashra (First 10 Days)
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.

duas.title: For Those Who Provide Iftar
duas.arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ
duas.transliteration: Aftara 'indakumus-sa'imun, wa akala ta'amakumul-abrar, wa sallat 'alaykumul-mala'ikah
duas.translation: May those who are fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angels pray for blessings upon you.
